title: Prove full-rank ternary disjointness repair in odd dimensions
body:
## Summary

For every odd h >= 3 and every field F of characteristic three, the disjointness matrix A_h on the nonempty proper subsets of [h] satisfies `rank_F(I-A_h)=2^h-2`. Thus its additive identity repair needs exactly 2^h-2 scalar rank-one terms. This is a scoped algebraic proof with an explicit inverse and bounded exact corroboration; no new kappa or physical supplier is claimed.

```text
K^4 = -I                    (characteristic three)
T = K tensor ... tensor K   (odd h gives T^4 = -I)
R = (I-T)^-1 = 2(I+T+T^2+T^3)
R[empty,full] = [[2,2],[2,0]] is invertible
=> deleting those endpoints leaves I-A_h invertible
```

Six new files in `research/ternary-disjointness-repair/` contain the proof, standalone checker and source-bound metadata. Scientific base: `a5df48c55ea806d7952b65acc9c76d878ff09b13`; contribution head: `50ee4f7069d7aabdcdfc44ebadf0456d8cf82e0c`.

## Evidence

- **Before:** Ali Romman's merged #4962 proves the binary repair rank; characteristic three is outside its theorem. Its tensor/deletion approach is credited and its proof/README are pinned as provenance. No predecessor verifier is imported or rerun.
- **After:** the written proof covers every odd h >= 3 and every characteristic-three field. Exact elimination gives ranks 6,30,126,510 at h=3,5,7,9. Literal full and corrected interior inverses pass at h=3,5,7. An independent census checks all 729 kernel vectors at h=3. Six controls reject invalid domains and omitted/wrong-sign endpoint corrections. The h=2 kernel vector (1,1) demonstrates the oddness boundary.

CPython 3.12.15, standard library only. Run from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/ternary-disjointness-repair
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/ternary-disjointness-repair/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/ternary-disjointness-repair/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/ternary-disjointness-repair --check-source-history
```

The two registered commands each passed locally in 0.73–0.74 seconds; the complete launcher passed in 1.67 seconds. These timings establish bounded replay, not a performance improvement. Source-history/committed-byte preflight passed for all six files. Official committed export integrity and a read-only, Git-free isolated optimized replay with `PATH=/nonexistent` passed; its generated source-hash report equals the direct replay's report. `git diff --check` passes.

Credit Ali Romman #4962, mikey1201 #172 and the icekylinx/#144 compiler/bookkeeping lineage. The new theorem and verifier are produced by Nick Petalas. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Apache-2.0.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This counts additive scalar rank-one terms. A ternary physical caller, coefficient preparation, paid reads/copies, dirty restoration, frames, compiler/stock/precision/tape costs and complete recursive/multiplication bounds are not supplied. No binary ledger is transferred. No selected cold replay, predecessor scientific suite, Lean or Docker run was performed.

The [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19144847) sought a first original rank statement; the first proved result settles odd h, and even dimensions remain open under the stop rule.

## Related open work

- #172 studies the same Boolean-lattice disjointness endpoint in a binary construction. This contribution changes the coefficient field and proves an additive repair obstruction; it does not evaluate that PR's projected invoice or resolve its physical semantic obligations.

Live targeted searches for `boolean-disjointness-repair` and `zeta-family`, main-tree/merged searches and recent claims found no other same-question open work. Sparse local notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits. Completion refresh examined this account's open PRs created since the advance CLAIM: nine including this PR. None of the other eight studies this Boolean-lattice disjointness repair or supplies a directly comparable rank value, so no additional related-work line or numerical comparison is required.

## Open next questions

- Determine rank_F3(I-A_h) for even h >= 4. Begin with the full tensor eigenspaces and the two-endpoint restriction when T^4=I; the odd-dimensional inverse is unavailable.
- Decide whether a nonadditive physical repair can evade this obstruction. First supply an exact all-input ternary identity and complete paid bill; neither is assumed here.
